items.headline: RBI projects FY27 CPI inflation at 5.0%; domestic activity resilient amid global uncertainty
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has projected CPI inflation for FY2026-27 at 5.0%, with Q2 at 4.7%, Q3 at 5.9%, and Q4 at 5.5%. Domestic economic activity remained resilient in Q1 FY27, backed by strong corporate earnings, robust domestic demand, and healthy exports, though inflation risks from rising crude oil prices and geopolitical developments persist.

items.headline: Indian markets expected to open lower due to weak global cues, US-Iran conflict, and Fed policy uncertainty
items.summary: Indian markets are anticipated to open lower today, reacting to weak global market cues, persistent Middle East tensions impacting crude oil prices, and shifting expectations regarding the US Federal Reserve's policy. The Indian stock market closed marginally lower on Friday, August 14, snapping a two-week winning streak.

items.headline: Q1 FY27 earnings season largely concludes, Nifty 50 performance exceeds expectations; several companies in focus
items.summary: The Q1 FY27 earnings season has mostly wrapped up, with the Nifty 50's performance comfortably exceeding market expectations and healthy earnings breadth across its constituents. SKF India has an earnings call today, while Sudarshan Chemical Industries and JSW Cement surpassed Q1 revenue and EPS forecasts. Engineers India and Galaxy Surfactants also reported strong Q1 FY27 performances. Other companies like Shreeram Proteins, Cressanda Railway Solutions, Indrayani Biotech, Indo-mim, Silverline Technologies, Bluegod Entertainment, Mahan Industries, and Velox Shipping and Logistics have scheduled quarterly results for today.

items.headline: Media, Consumer Durables, IT Services outperform; Financials, Pharma under pressure; Telecom, New-Age, Capital Goods, Defence gain
items.summary: Last week, the Media, Consumer Durables, and IT Services sectors showed stronger performance, while Financial Services and Pharma sectors experienced pressure. The Telecom, New-Age businesses, and Capital Goods sectors saw gains of 1% to 4%, with defence stocks also rallying. Mid- and small-cap stocks generally saw sharper declines compared to benchmark indices.

items.headline: Multiple companies go ex-dividend today; Bizotic Commercial announces bonus issue
items.summary: Several companies, including Bandhan Bank, Delta Corp, Fabtech Technologies, Hisar Metal Industries, Housing & Urban Development Corporation, Indo Count Industries, Manappuram Finance, NBCC (India), Panama Petrochem, Plastiblends India, Silver Touch Technologies, SKF India, and The Yamuna Syndicate, have ex-dividend dates today, August 17, 2026. Bizotic Commercial Limited also has a bonus issue in the ratio of 5:1 today.

items.headline: Bharti Airtel rises on broad telecom sector strength; Welspun Living surges over 10% post strong Q1 FY27 results
items.summary: Bharti Airtel saw a 3% rise on August 14, driven by overall strength in the telecom sector. Welspun Living surged over 10% after reporting strong Q1 FY27 results, placing both stocks in investor focus.
